title: Project: website status changed v1
description: DRAFT, proposed by project, waits for provisioning. Owner: project. The owner took one of their websites offline, or switched it back on (API v2 PATCH /api/project/v2/projects/{projectId} {"status"}; v1 POST .../suspend and .../reactivate). Kept apart from owner_status_changed.v1 (the account) so Provisioning can record an owner-chosen offline reason that never clashes with billing or admin. status is suspended or active; status_version grows by one with each change of this website, so a consumer ignores an older or equal version. subdomain is the site's DNS label; a website without one (never deployed) is not sent. Exchange project.events, routing key website_status_changed.v1, persistent, application/json, AMQP type = message_type, sent after the database commit.
